visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The man with short black hair, wearing a black tank top, is seated on a tiled floor in a cluttered indoor room. A Corgi with a pink collar jumps enthusiastically on his chest, licking his chin. The man has a playful expression, squinting his eyes and smiling while gently holding the dog's side with his tattooed arm. In the background, there are white metal shelves filled with colorful items, a brown cardboard box with the Chinese text 'PP 夾鏈袋', and a white oscillating fan. (2) The camera angle remains low and handheld as the interaction continues. The man pushes the dog away slightly to avoid the saliva, while another Corgi with a green collar sits calmly in the background, watching the scene. The lighting is bright and indoor-based, illuminating the beige tiled floor and the surrounding cardboard boxes. (3) The man reaches out to pet the green-collared Corgi on the head. The dog closes its eyes and opens its mouth in a panting smile, showing its teeth. The pink-collared Corgi wanders out of the frame towards the back of the room. The background shows a white cabinet and more stored household items, suggesting a home-office or shop storage environment. (4) The scene shifts to a different part of the home, likely a kitchen or dining area. A woman wearing a black and white checkered shirt stands at a kitchen counter with her back to the camera. The pink-collared Corgi stands on the floor, looking up at her and barking loudly, wagging its tail. A television screen is visible in the background displaying colorful graphics, near a pink dining table and chairs.

(2) A sharp, loud bark occurs as the man says 'Duōduō bù kěyǐ la,' his voice rising in pitch and intensity. The sound of the dog panting is clearly audible near the microphone. The ambient noise is minimal, characteristic of a quiet indoor room, focusing purely on the vocal-pet interaction. (3) The man's voice becomes more teasing and humorous, saying 'Lǐ kǒushuǐ hǎo chòu' (your saliva smells bad) while continuing to giggle. The sound of his hand rhythmically patting the dog's fur creates soft, muffled thudding noises. The vocal delivery is fast-paced and high-valence. (4) The acoustic environment shifts as a woman's voice is heard faintly in the background, speaking in a calm, melodic tone. The Corgi's barks become more persistent and demanding, sounding sharper against the room's harder surfaces. A faint, continuous hum from a distant television provides a low-level ambient floor.
